title: pvConvertAMRdatasettoMultiblock
body:
## pvConvertAMRdatasettoMultiblock

Converts overlapping AMR data (vtkOverlappingAMR) into a multiblock dataset whose leaves are the individual uniform-grid blocks, so filters or writers that do not understand AMR can process them. The result is a flat multiblock with one block per AMR grid, listed level by level; grids are shallow copies, so their arrays (including any blanking array) are kept, but level and refinement metadata are lost and coarse cells covered by finer levels are not removed. Use pvResampleAMR instead when you need a single uniform grid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Overlapping levels mean the same region appears at several resolutions; integrals or statistics over all blocks count it more than once unless hidden cells are removed.
- Non-overlapping AMR is not accepted by this filter.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertAMRdatasettoMultiblock`. Identity: `filters/AMRToMultiBlock`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
